{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pentakus Crater''' was a massive crater on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taskeed/Legends|Taskeed]] that was created during a [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] weapons test during the rule of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot. Its origin was completely forgotten until the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when sensor mappings showed that it was not natural. Archaeologists would be sent to study how and why it came to be.<ref name="Leaving a Mark">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Leaving a Mark}}</ref>
